Coram : B.S. CHAUHAN*, SWATANTER KUMAR
627 NARESH KUMAR v. DEPARTMENT OF ATOMIC ENERGY AND ORS. (Civil Appeal No. 3138 of 2008) JULY 08, 2010 [DR. 8.5. CHAUHAN AND SWATANTER KUMAR, JJ.) A B Service Law - Pension - Multiple pension options - Appellant opted for pro-rata pension - Later made representation seeking change in option and as on merits - Propriety of - Held: Proper- The relief claimed by appellant was misconceived and could not be granted on the facts of D the case - Moreover, appellant, without giving any explanation, approached the writ court long after his representation was rejected by the authorities - Delay I
Decision Date : 08-07-2010 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3138/2008 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
